text.tspan: Controller → Service → Repository → EF Core. Selected signatures; cancellation tokens and generic return wrappers are omitted.
LEGEND: dashed open arrow = dependency; dashed hollow triangle = interface implementation; solid hollow triangle = class inheritance.
IAttendanceRepository also extends IGenericRepository<AttendanceRecord> (contract omitted). AttendanceRepository reuses GenericRepository; no separate session repository.
NotificationDispatcher inherits BackgroundService; NotificationHub inherits Hub. IHubContext.Clients.User(...).SendAsync(...) targets the authenticated parent UserId.
DTOs SaveAttendanceDto / AttendanceInput carry RosterToken and Version; entities and their relationships are shown in the domain class diagram.
